Seattle, Washington · stay

Hotels in Seattle for cyclists

Where to sleep in Seattle when you’re here to ride. Book early for event weekends.

For: Seattle to Portland Bicycle Classic.

Hotels in Seattle for cyclists, listed

1 with a bike policy in writing · 7 to ask.

  1. HI Seattle at the American Hotel

    • 520 S King St, Seattle, WA 98104
    • $
    • Bike: Bike storage in the basement; the front desk walks you down to store or fetch your bike (its FAQ’s words).
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about HI Seattle at the American Hotel

    A hostel in the Chinatown–International District, a block from the King Street light-rail and Amtrak station and about a mile south of the center of downtown; Cascade’s 2026 list puts it 4.4 miles from the STP start. Travelers only, it won’t take Seattle-area residents, and 14 nights at most. Check-in 3, out 11; luggage storage after check-out is $5 for two bags; a pay lot across the street. The cheap tier for this guide, and the one place in town with the bike rule in writing. No rate shown on its own page (Oct 2026).

  2. College Inn

    On the Ave at NE 40th, 0.6 mile from the STP start lot by Cascade’s 2026 list, the closest bed on it.

    • 4000 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about College Inn

    A 1909 building run as a small inn: half the rooms have a new private bath, the rest share; free coffee and tea all day in the loft. Nothing about bikes on its page, and nothing about an elevator. No rate shown (Oct 2026).

  3. University Inn (Staypineapple)

    Roosevelt Way at NE 41st, 1.3 miles from the STP start lot by Cascade’s 2026 list, with Portage Bay Cafe next door.

    • 4140 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about University Inn (Staypineapple)

    The hotel lists beach cruisers to borrow; nothing on its page about where your own bike sleeps. Self-parking on site, fee not shown. No rate shown (Oct 2026).

  4. Residence Inn by Marriott Seattle University District

    On 12th Ave NE in the U District, 1.3 miles from the STP start lot by Cascade’s 2026 list.

    • 4501 12th Avenue NE, Seattle, WA 98105
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Residence Inn by Marriott Seattle University District

    The suites have full kitchens, and that matters on STP morning: hotel breakfast starts at 7 a.m. on weekends and the ride leaves at 5. Nothing about bikes on the hotel’s page. No rate shown; parking $35 a day (Oct 2026).

  5. Watertown Hotel (Staypineapple)

    A block north of its sister, the University Inn, on Roosevelt Way.

    • 4242 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Watertown Hotel (Staypineapple)

    Cascade’s 2026 list puts it 1.8 miles from the STP start lot, half a mile farther than the University Inn. Beach cruisers to borrow, per the page; nothing about your own bike. No rate shown (Oct 2026).

  6. Graduate by Hilton Seattle

    Brooklyn Ave at NE 45th, a few blocks west of campus.

    • 4507 Brooklyn Ave NE, Seattle, WA 98105
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Graduate by Hilton Seattle

    Not on Cascade’s lodging list, so no measured distance to the start. Two restaurants (Poindexter Coffee on the ground floor, the Mountaineering Club bar on the roof). A daily mandatory destination charge covers internet, a $15 food credit and bicycle rentals; nothing on the page about a guest’s own bike. Valet only, $46 a day; no rate shown (Oct 2026).

  7. Hotel Max

    Downtown, Stewart St at 7th, half a mile from Pike Place Market and about a mile from the Elliott Bay Trail at the waterfront.

    • 620 Stewart St, Seattle, WA 98101
    • $$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about Hotel Max

    Colman Dock and the Bainbridge ferry are a downhill roll away. The hotel’s own page says it loans Public bikes to guests; Expedia’s listing goes further and puts “Bicycle storage” inside the $34.22-a-night resort fee, but that line isn’t on the hotel’s site, so ask when you book. From $204 for a mid-October night, taxes in; covered valet $55.98 (Expedia, Sept 2026).

  8. Silver Cloud Hotel Seattle – Broadway

    • 1100 Broadway, Seattle, WA 98122
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Silver Cloud Hotel Seattle – Broadway

    Broadway at Madison, where Capitol Hill meets First Hill: the Pike/Pine bars, Métier’s rental counter and the start of Good Weather’s Sunday Social (Sundays, 10:30 am) are a short roll north, downtown a long downhill west. Check-in 4, out noon. Nothing about bikes on the hotel’s page. No rate shown (Oct 2026).
